say:0:1623252001:0.text: Wonder how those two are holding up... I'll ask Professor Hepler.
say:0:1623252001:0.source_cn: 不知那两个小家伙过得怎样了……去赫普老师那儿打听一下。
say:0:1623252001:0.male: Wonder how those two are holding up... I'll ask Professor Hepler.
say:0:1623252001:0.female: Wonder how those two are holding up... I'll ask Professor Hepler.

say:1:1623253001:0.source_cn: 枭熊大人、魔法师大人……我们……

say:3:1623253002:0.text: We... We need your help. It's about Candel and Sweep. We'd like them to come back.
say:3:1623253002:0.source_cn: 我们想请你们帮个忙……是关于坎德尔和斯威普的。我们……...
say:3:1623253002:0.male: We... We need your help. It's about Candel and Sweep. We'd like them to come back.
say:3:1623253002:0.female: We... We need your help. It's about Candel and Sweep. We'd like them to come back.

choice_prompt:4:1623253002.text: We... We need your help. It's about Candel and Sweep. We'd like them to come back.
choice_prompt:4:1623253002.source_cn: 我们想请你们帮个忙……是关于坎德尔和斯威普的。我们……我们希望他们能回来。
choice_prompt:4:1623253002.male: We... We need your help. It's about Candel and Sweep. We'd like them to come back.
choice_prompt:4:1623253002.female: We... We need your help. It's about Candel and Sweep. We'd like them to come back.

say:6:1623253003:0.text: Y-Yeah... We said a lot of awful things in the heat of the moment...
say:6:1623253003:0.source_cn: 是、是的……现在回想起来，我们因为一时气愤，对他们说了...

say:8:1623253004:0.text: But they didn't run when the poachers came. Instead, they protected us without thinking twice. Without them... our babies would be gone by now.
say:8:1623253004:0.source_cn: 但上次偷猎者来的时候，是他们不顾危险挡在了前面！要不是...
say:8:1623253004:0.male: But they didn't run when the poachers came. Instead, they protected us without thinking twice. Without them... our babies would be gone by now.
say:8:1623253004:0.female: But they didn't run when the poachers came. Instead, they protected us without thinking twice. Without them... our babies would be gone by now.

say:9:1623253005:0.text: After that... my friends and I started seeing them differently.
say:9:1623253005:0.source_cn: 在这件事之后，我和朋友们对他们的看法……的确有所改变。
say:9:1623253005:0.male: After that... my friends and I started seeing them differently.
say:9:1623253005:0.female: After that... my friends and I started seeing them differently.

say:10:1623253006:0.text: Yeah, they don't understand our animal ways, and it's been a headache. But they did their best to fit in and look out for us... while we refused to do the same for them.
say:10:1623253006:0.source_cn: 他们虽然无法彻底理解我们动物的生活方式，却在努力融入我...
say:10:1623253006:0.male: Yeah, they don't understand our animal ways, and it's been a headache. But they did their best to fit in and look out for us... while we refused to do the same for them.
say:10:1623253006:0.female: Yeah, they don't understand our animal ways, and it's been a headache. But they did their best to fit in and look out for us... while we refused to do the same for them.

say:12:1623253007:0.text: I'm not pretending it'll be perfect. Calling them back doesn't fix everything overnight...
say:12:1623253007:0.source_cn: 我知道，他们和我们之间，总会有这样或者那样的矛盾存在。...

say:13:1623253008:0.text: But maybe... maybe we can actually find a way?
say:13:1623253008:0.source_cn: 但或许，或许我们能找到一个解决问题的办法？

say:14:1623253009:0.text: Why don't you bring them back yourselves, then?
say:14:1623253009:0.source_cn: 既然意识到了误会，为什么不亲自去请他们回森林呢？

say:15:1623253010:1.text: We tried... but we're no hunters. We can't even find a trace to start with. That's why we're asking for your help!
say:15:1623253010:1.source_cn: 我们试过了……可我们不像猎手那样擅长追踪，根本找不到他...

say:17:1623253011:1.text: Yeah. Once they're back, we'll gather the others and talk it through. Trust is a two-way trail. They stepped forward first; now it's our turn.
say:17:1623253011:1.source_cn: 是的，等他们回来，我们会召集其他的动物，和他们一起好好...

say:19:1623253012:0.text: We found these in the forest... You're the real mages here. Surely, you can track them down with these, can't you?
say:19:1623253012:0.source_cn: 这是我们在森林里找到的，你们都会很厉害的魔法，一定能用...
say:19:1623253012:0.male: We found these in the forest... You're the real mages here. Surely, you can track them down with these, can't you?
say:19:1623253012:0.female: We found these in the forest... You're the real mages here. Surely, you can track them down with these, can't you?

say:22:1623253013:0.text: The rabbit offers a slightly curled broom sprout, while the squirrel cradles a drop of hardened wax like an acorn she's kept safe for winter.
say:22:1623253013:0.source_cn: 兔子递来一根微微卷曲的笤帚苗，松鼠则捧来一滴已然凝固的...

choice_prompt:23:1623253013.text: The rabbit offers a slightly curled broom sprout, while the squirrel cradles a drop of hardened wax like an acorn she's kept safe for winter.
choice_prompt:23:1623253013.source_cn: 兔子递来一根微微卷曲的笤帚苗，松鼠则捧来一滴已然凝固的蜡油，像是珍藏已久的宝物。

say:24:1623253014:0.text: Thank you, Magister. We're counting on you.
say:24:1623253014:0.male: Thank you, Magister. We're counting on you.
say:24:1623253014:0.female: Thank you, Magister. We're counting on you.

say:0:1623254001:0.text: Candel's broom sprout... Transfiguration can help me find him.
say:0:1623254001:0.source_cn: 熟悉的笤帚苗，忽然有点好奇坎德尔会去哪里……用变形术追...
say:0:1623254001:0.male: Candel's broom sprout... Transfiguration can help me find him.
say:0:1623254001:0.female: Candel's broom sprout... Transfiguration can help me find him.

say:0:1623255001:0.text: This feeling... Holt Street? How did Candel end up there?
say:0:1623255001:0.source_cn: 霍尔特商业街？坎德尔怎么突然对那里感兴趣了……
say:0:1623255001:0.male: This feeling... Holt Street? How did Candel end up there?
say:0:1623255001:0.female: This feeling... Holt Street? How did Candel end up there?

say:2:1623257002:0.text: Sorry. I don't think we can hire you.
say:2:1623257002:0.source_cn: 抱歉，我们恐怕不能录用你。

say:3:1623257003:1.text: W-What? Why? Am I... not trying hard enough?
say:3:1623257003:1.source_cn: 为、为什么？是我还不够努力吗？

say:4:1623257004:1.text: No, it's just that... every time you sweep, dust flies everywhere. People take one look and walk away. I can't run a shop like that.
say:4:1623257004:1.source_cn: 不是努力的问题。你一扫地就扬起漫天灰尘，客人都被吓跑了。

say:5:1623257005:1.text: I'll keep you on our list of potential cleaners. If an opening comes up, I'll reach out.
say:5:1623257005:1.source_cn: 不过你已经进入了我们清洁工备选名单，如果后面有需求，我...

say:6:1623257006:1.text: A-Ah... Could you give me one more chance, maybe? I can sweep gently. I swear I won't kick up dust!
say:6:1623257006:1.source_cn: 啊……先生，你不再考虑一下吗？我可以轻轻地扫，保证不起灰！

say:9:1623257008:1.text: Without even looking back, the trader waves him off and disappears around the corner.
say:9:1623257008:1.source_cn: 商贩头也不回地摆了摆手，消失在街角。

say:11:1623257009:1.text: Well... on the bright side, I can clock out early today! Oh, Magister! Didn't expect to run into you here!
say:11:1623257009:1.source_cn: 唉，往好处想，至少今天可以提前收工……咦，魔法师大人，...
say:11:1623257009:1.male: Well... on the bright side, I can clock out early today! Oh, Magister! Didn't expect to run into you here!
say:11:1623257009:1.female: Well... on the bright side, I can clock out early today! Oh, Magister! Didn't expect to run into you here!

choice_prompt:12:1623257009.text: Well... on the bright side, I can clock out early today! Oh, Magister! Didn't expect to run into you here!
choice_prompt:12:1623257009.source_cn: 唉，往好处想，至少今天可以提前收工……咦，魔法师大人，没想到会在这里碰见你！
choice_prompt:12:1623257009.male: Well... on the bright side, I can clock out early today! Oh, Magister! Didn't expect to run into you here!
choice_prompt:12:1623257009.female: Well... on the bright side, I can clock out early today! Oh, Magister! Didn't expect to run into you here!

say:13:1623257010:1.source_cn: 难道……你是来特地找我的？

say:14:1623257012:1.text: D-Don't tell me... the animals want me and Sweep to pay for all the burned trees and flowers?!
say:14:1623257012:1.source_cn: 难道……难道那些动物们要我和斯威普赔偿被烧坏的树木花草？！
say:14:1623257012:1.male: D-Don't tell me... the animals want me and Sweep to pay for all the burned trees and flowers?!
say:14:1623257012:1.female: D-Don't tell me... the animals want me and Sweep to pay for all the burned trees and flowers?!

say:15:1623257013:1.text: But I'm broke...! Look at me! I can't even land a decent job!
say:15:1623257013:1.source_cn: 可我没有钱啊……你看，我连一份像样的工作都找不到！
say:15:1623257013:1.male: But I'm broke...! Look at me! I can't even land a decent job!
say:15:1623257013:1.female: But I'm broke...! Look at me! I can't even land a decent job!

choice_prompt:16:1623257013.text: But I'm broke...! Look at me! I can't even land a decent job!
choice_prompt:16:1623257013.source_cn: 可我没有钱啊……你看，我连一份像样的工作都找不到！
choice_prompt:16:1623257013.male: But I'm broke...! Look at me! I can't even land a decent job!
choice_prompt:16:1623257013.female: But I'm broke...! Look at me! I can't even land a decent job!

say:17:1623257014:1.text: What? The animals... want to have us back? And a meeting to figure out how we get along?
say:17:1623257014:1.source_cn: 什么？那些动物……要请我回森林？还要开讨论会聊聊以后怎...
say:17:1623257014:1.male: What? The animals... want to have us back? And a meeting to figure out how we get along?
say:17:1623257014:1.female: What? The animals... want to have us back? And a meeting to figure out how we get along?

say:18:1623257015:1.text: N-No! Easier said than done... Besides, I've already left. No way I'm going back! Period!
say:18:1623257015:1.source_cn: 我……我拒绝！他们才不会理解我们呢……既然已经离开，我...
say:18:1623257015:1.male: N-No! Easier said than done... Besides, I've already left. No way I'm going back! Period!
say:18:1623257015:1.female: N-No! Easier said than done... Besides, I've already left. No way I'm going back! Period!

say:20:1623257016:1.text: He refuses without hesitation, but you catch his bristles twitching, and his voice softens in a way he doesn't seem to notice.
say:20:1623257016:1.source_cn: 尽管坎德尔拒绝得干脆，你却注意到他说话时，扫帚穗不自觉...
say:20:1623257016:1.male: He refuses without hesitation, but you catch his bristles twitching, and his voice softens in a way he doesn't seem to notice.
say:20:1623257016:1.female: He refuses without hesitation, but you catch his bristles twitching, and his voice softens in a way he doesn't seem to notice.

say:21:1623257017:1.text: He won't admit it, but you can tell he's tempted. You just need a little conversational trick... like asking his partner, Sweep. Sometimes, taking a detour can lead to a nice surprise.
say:21:1623257017:1.source_cn: 虽然他不愿松口，但你心里很清楚，他对此十分心动。你只需...
say:21:1623257017:1.male: He won't admit it, but you can tell he's tempted. You just need a little conversational trick... like asking his partner, Sweep. Sometimes, taking a detour can lead to a nice surprise.
say:21:1623257017:1.female: He won't admit it, but you can tell he's tempted. You just need a little conversational trick... like asking his partner, Sweep. Sometimes, taking a detour can lead to a nice surprise.

choice_prompt:22:1623257017.text: He won't admit it, but you can tell he's tempted. You just need a little conversational trick... like asking his partner, Sweep. Sometimes, taking a detour can lead to a nice surprise.
choice_prompt:22:1623257017.source_cn: 虽然他不愿松口，但你心里很清楚，他对此十分心动。你只需要一点谈话小技巧……例如问问他的搭档斯威普，让斯威普替他应下这个提议。
choice_prompt:22:1623257017.male: He won't admit it, but you can tell he's tempted. You just need a little conversational trick... like asking his partner, Sweep. Sometimes, taking a detour can lead to a nice surprise.
choice_prompt:22:1623257017.female: He won't admit it, but you can tell he's tempted. You just need a little conversational trick... like asking his partner, Sweep. Sometimes, taking a detour can lead to a nice surprise.

say:24:1623257018:0.text: Sweep... *Cough* Well, I can't make that call for him. Better we find him and hear it from him.
say:24:1623257018:0.source_cn: 斯威普啊……咳，我无法替他做出决定，不如我们去找他，让...
say:24:1623257018:0.male: Sweep... *Cough* Well, I can't make that call for him. Better we find him and hear it from him.
say:24:1623257018:0.female: Sweep... *Cough* Well, I can't make that call for him. Better we find him and hear it from him.

say:25:1623257019:1.text: I'm confident he feels the same. Definitely. One hundred percent... Yeah...
say:25:1623257019:1.source_cn: 虽然我很确定他也不想回去……嗯，绝对也不想……我确定……
say:25:1623257019:1.male: I'm confident he feels the same. Definitely. One hundred percent... Yeah...
say:25:1623257019:1.female: I'm confident he feels the same. Definitely. One hundred percent... Yeah...

say:26:1623257020:1.text: Come on. Let's go. I've been wondering how he's doing. He might've even found a real job by now.
say:26:1623257020:1.source_cn: 走吧走吧，我们赶紧去找他。我还真有点想那家伙，说不定他...
say:26:1623257020:1.male: Come on. Let's go. I've been wondering how he's doing. He might've even found a real job by now.
say:26:1623257020:1.female: Come on. Let's go. I've been wondering how he's doing. He might've even found a real job by now.

choice:22:0:1.text: You can decide together with Sweep.
choice:22:0:1.source_cn: 你可以跟斯威普一起决定
choice:22:0:1.male: You can decide together with Sweep.
choice:22:0:1.female: You can decide together with Sweep.

choice:12:1:2.text: I came here looking for you.
choice:12:1:2.male: I came here looking for you.
choice:12:1:2.female: I came here looking for you.

say:0:1623258001:0.text: Off we go! Let's find Sweep!
say:0:1623258001:0.male: Off we go! Let's find Sweep!
say:0:1623258001:0.female: Off we go! Let's find Sweep!

say:1:1623260001:0.text: Maybe... you could tell me how to become livestock?
say:1:1623260001:0.source_cn: 也许……你可以告诉我，怎样才能成为家畜？

say:2:1623260002:0.text: It sounds like a great job. Food, drink... and an owner who takes care of you.
say:2:1623260002:0.source_cn: 我觉得家畜这份工作很不错，有吃有喝，还可以被主人一直照...

say:3:1623260003:0.text: Baa... What's so great about it...? Everyone ends up the same way. Run while you can...
say:3:1623260003:0.source_cn: 咩……家畜有什么好，大家最后只有那个结局，快逃……

say:4:1623260004:1.text: What way...? What do you mean?

say:5:1623260005:1.text: Phew, I wish Candel were here. He's way sharper than I am. He'd know what Mr. Sheep meant.
say:5:1623260005:1.source_cn: 呼，要是坎德尔在就好了，他比我聪明多，一定可以理解羊先...

say:6:1623260006:1.text: I hope he's landed a job. When will I get to see him again? I miss our talks.
say:6:1623260006:1.source_cn: 不知道他找到工作了没有，好想和他聊聊天啊……

say:10:1623260008:0.source_cn: 是坎德尔！还有魔法师大人！

say:11:1623260009:0.text: Look at you! It's been a while—uh... is it just me, or is your flame looking a little dimmer?
say:11:1623260009:0.source_cn: 怎么样啊？有阵子没见了——是我的错觉吗，怎么觉得你的烛...

say:12:1623260010:0.text: I-Is it? Could be the job-hunting... No one wants a lighting candle, and nobody thinks I can handle night watch, either...
say:12:1623260010:0.source_cn: 有、有吗？可能是因为找工作太累了，毕竟既没有人愿意让我...

choice_prompt:13:1623260010.text: I-Is it? Could be the job-hunting... No one wants a lighting candle, and nobody thinks I can handle night watch, either...
choice_prompt:13:1623260010.source_cn: 有、有吗？可能是因为找工作太累了，毕竟既没有人愿意让我当照明蜡烛，也没有人觉得我能做夜班守卫……

say:14:1623260011:0.text: Offer... for me? Someone's offering me a job and they had you deliver it?
say:14:1623260011:0.source_cn: 邀请？是给我的吗？居然有人邀请我工作，还能请到魔法师大...
say:14:1623260011:0.male: Offer... for me? Someone's offering me a job and they had you deliver it?
say:14:1623260011:0.female: Offer... for me? Someone's offering me a job and they had you deliver it?

choice_prompt:15:1623260011.text: Offer... for me? Someone's offering me a job and they had you deliver it?
choice_prompt:15:1623260011.source_cn: 邀请？是给我的吗？居然有人邀请我工作，还能请到魔法师大人来送这份邀请书？
choice_prompt:15:1623260011.male: Offer... for me? Someone's offering me a job and they had you deliver it?
choice_prompt:15:1623260011.female: Offer... for me? Someone's offering me a job and they had you deliver it?

say:16:1623260012:0.text: For real? Th-They mean it? They want to take us in?!
say:16:1623260012:0.source_cn: 真的吗？他们……真是那么说的？他们真的愿意试着接纳我们？！
say:16:1623260012:0.male: For real? Th-They mean it? They want to take us in?!
say:16:1623260012:0.female: For real? Th-They mean it? They want to take us in?!

choice_prompt:17:1623260012.text: For real? Th-They mean it? They want to take us in?!
choice_prompt:17:1623260012.source_cn: 真的吗？他们……真是那么说的？他们真的愿意试着接纳我们？！
choice_prompt:17:1623260012.male: For real? Th-They mean it? They want to take us in?!
choice_prompt:17:1623260012.female: For real? Th-They mean it? They want to take us in?!

say:18:1623260013:1.text: I can't believe it! Candel, what do you think? Should we say yes?
say:18:1623260013:1.source_cn: 简直难以置信！坎德尔，我们该怎么办，要不要……回去？

say:19:1623260014:1.text: Honestly... I've missed the forest. I can't shake off the awful parts, of course, but every time I close my eyes and imagine the smell of green and the rustling of leaves... I just feel safe again.
say:19:1623260014:1.source_cn: 其实……我这段时间一直很想念森林的生活。那些糟糕的事我...

say:20:1623260015:1.text: It's strange. I'm a magical creation made by humans, yet I crave the feel of soft soil, with pine needles covering it...
say:20:1623260015:1.source_cn: 真奇怪，我明明是人类创造的魔法造物，却每天都在怀念脚踩...

say:22:1623260017:1.text: We left because we had to. Since they're holding out an olive branch, we should accept it. No?
say:22:1623260017:1.source_cn: 我们是因为动物们的反对才离开森林的，既然现在他们改变了...

say:23:1623260018:1.text: Don't act like we're desperate. It's just a forest. There's nothing special about it...
say:23:1623260018:1.source_cn: 别说得好像我们没有其他选择了似的，森林也没什么了不起的……

say:24:1623260019:1.text: They've made the offer. And as two-of-a-kind magical creations, the proper thing is to accept. That's called... basic etiquette.
say:24:1623260019:1.source_cn: 不过既然那群动物向我们发出了邀请，作为独二无三的魔法造...

say:27:1623260021:1.text: The decision is made. Sweep's flame pops brighter and Candel's bristles spring back to life.
say:27:1623260021:1.source_cn: 在他们达成了一致决定之后，小蜡烛的火焰“噗”地亮了一截...

say:28:1623260022:1.text: But it only lasts a moment. The memory of the animals' cruel words and cold looks hits them both, and they slow down.
say:28:1623260022:1.source_cn: 但兴奋只有一瞬，两人似乎同时回想起了动物们拒绝他们时的...

say:31:1623260024:1.text: I know. Let's just... go back for us. To see it through. And if it goes bad... we can leave anytime.
say:31:1623260024:1.source_cn: 我明白的，就当是为了实现我们自己的愿望，再回去一次。大...

say:35:1623260027:1.source_cn: 现在就出发吧，魔法师大人。

choice:17:0:1.text: Why would I lie about that?
choice:17:0:1.male: Why would I lie about that?
choice:17:0:1.female: Why would I lie about that?

choice:17:1:2.text: I swear it on my good name.
choice:17:1:2.male: I swear it on my good name.
choice:17:1:2.female: I swear it on my good name.

say:0:1623261001:0.text: They're all here... Time to transfigure and join them.
say:0:1623261001:0.source_cn: 动物们果然聚集在这里了，该用变形术了。
say:0:1623261001:0.male: They're all here... Time to transfigure and join them.
say:0:1623261001:0.female: They're all here... Time to transfigure and join them.

say:1:1623262002:0.text: Easy now... Have a little snack first.

say:2:1623262003:0.text: Mmm. The grass here is good.

say:0:1623265001:0.text: Forest... The first leaf kissed by morning light...
say:0:1623265001:0.source_cn: 森林啊……是晨光亲吻的第一片叶

say:1:1623265002:0.text: The softest whisper brushed by the breeze...
say:1:1623265002:0.source_cn: 是微风拂过最柔软的絮语……

say:0:1623266001:0.text: You arrive with Candel and Sweep at your side, and the forest falls quiet all at once.
say:0:1623266001:0.source_cn: 你带着坎德尔和斯威普，一起出现在动物们的面前，森林里顿...
say:0:1623266001:0.male: You arrive with Candel and Sweep at your side, and the forest falls quiet all at once.
say:0:1623266001:0.female: You arrive with Candel and Sweep at your side, and the forest falls quiet all at once.

say:2:1623266002:0.text: I believe you all have heard why we're here today. It's about Mr. Candel and Mr. Sweep.
say:2:1623266002:0.source_cn: 这次召集大家的原因，想必大家也都知道——是关于坎德尔先...

say:3:1623266003:0.text: They wanted to be one of us once, and we turned them away. What happened with the poachers was a wake-up call and an opportunity to reopen this conversation.
say:3:1623266003:0.source_cn: 他们曾想要成为我们中的一员，但被我们拒绝了。可在经历了...

say:5:1623266004:0.text: The crowd erupts at once, chirps, snorts, yaps, and whispers... Some are for it, some against, but most are simply unsure.
say:5:1623266004:0.source_cn: 动物们顿时炸开了锅，开始你一言我一语地议论起来。这些声...
say:5:1623266004:0.male: The crowd erupts at once, chirps, snorts, yaps, and whispers... Some are for it, some against, but most are simply unsure.
say:5:1623266004:0.female: The crowd erupts at once, chirps, snorts, yaps, and whispers... Some are for it, some against, but most are simply unsure.

say:8:1623266006:0.text: Quiet, please! One at a time!
say:8:1623266006:0.source_cn: 请大家安静！一个一个发表意见！

say:9:1623266007:1.text: I mean, yes, Mr. Candel and Mr. Sweep have been a headache, but I can't forget what they did for my babies that day.
say:9:1623266007:1.source_cn: 坎德尔和斯威普两位先生的确闹出过不少令人头疼的混乱……...
say:9:1623266007:1.male: I mean, yes, Mr. Candel and Mr. Sweep have been a headache, but I can't forget what they did for my babies that day.
say:9:1623266007:1.female: I mean, yes, Mr. Candel and Mr. Sweep have been a headache, but I can't forget what they did for my babies that day.

say:10:1623266008:0.text: Without them, many of us might've been hurt or even worse. So... I'm asking that we give them one more chance.
say:10:1623266008:0.source_cn: 如果没有他们，恐怕很多动物都会遭殃。所以……我希望大家...
say:10:1623266008:0.male: Without them, many of us might've been hurt or even worse. So... I'm asking that we give them one more chance.
say:10:1623266008:0.female: Without them, many of us might've been hurt or even worse. So... I'm asking that we give them one more chance.

say:11:1623266009:0.text: Neigh! They proved themselves in that fight against the poachers. We should thank them and never forget it.
say:11:1623266009:0.source_cn: 咴，他们在偷猎者一事中功绩完全值得我们感激、赞美和传颂。

say:12:1623266010:0.text: But that doesn't erase the past. If they're staying, we have to address what went wrong before together. Coexistence can't be built on avoidance.
say:12:1623266010:0.source_cn: 但如果他们想成为森林中的一员，那么就必须解决之前暴露出...

say:14:1623266011:0.text: It's sharp, but fair. The forest answers with approving sounds, and Candel and Sweep nod along.
say:14:1623266011:0.source_cn: 马儿的话虽然尖锐，却也有道理，动物们纷纷表示认同。坎德...

say:16:1623266012:0.text: Sweeping away the grass beside a burrow, causing a forest fire... Either one could put all of us into great danger.
say:16:1623266012:0.source_cn: 无论是破坏掉兔子窝边的草，还是引起森林火灾，这对我们来...

say:17:1623266013:0.text: Who's to say it won't happen again? Or it might be worse. I'm not spending my life bracing for disaster!
say:17:1623266013:0.source_cn: 随时可能燃起的森林大火和随时会失去伪装的巢穴——这相当...

say:20:1623266014:0.text: About that... W-We owe you an apology.
say:20:1623266014:0.source_cn: 关于这一点，我……我们必须向大家道歉。

say:21:1623266015:1.text: I was just too excited to be here back then. I believed if we did enough, you'd take us in.
say:21:1623266015:1.source_cn: 那时候我只顾着因为来到森林而兴奋，一厢情愿地以为只要让...

say:22:1623266016:1.text: But we never took the time to know you. Never asked if you needed our "help"... Turns out it might be the last thing you need.
say:22:1623266016:1.source_cn: 可我们却从没了解过大家的生活，也根本没想过大家是否需要...

say:24:1623266017:0.text: No... Mr. Broom. I need your help.
say:24:1623266017:0.source_cn: 不是的，扫帚先生，你的帮助……我需要的。

say:25:1623266018:1.text: I got hurt on thorns one day. Mr. Broom wrapped my wound with broom sprouts and fresh grass to stop the bleeding. I was crying so hard... and he... he sang to me.
say:25:1623266018:1.source_cn: 那天我被荆棘扎伤，是扫帚先生用扫帚苗和嫩草帮我捆扎伤口...

say:26:1623266019:1.text: It wasn't exactly beautiful, but somehow it worked. It didn't hurt anymore.
say:26:1623266019:1.source_cn: 他的歌声虽然不像鸟儿那样优美，但很奇怪，后来我就真的不...

say:27:1623266020:1.source_cn: 咳……那首歌可是我练习很久的。

say:28:1623266021:1.text: Later, he said he wanted the forest "nice and tidy," so none of us would get stabbed by thorns again.
say:28:1623266021:1.source_cn: 后来他说想把森林打扫得整齐干净，这样的话，我们就再也不...

say:29:1623266022:1.text: Maybe we just need to say it clearly: don't sweep the grass and branches by our homes. Then he'll listen, right?
say:29:1623266022:1.source_cn: 我想……只要我们告诉扫帚先生不要扫掉家门口的草和树枝，...

say:32:1623266024:1.text: Baa... So it's settled? What about the fire? I was terrified. I keep dreaming my wool goes up in flames...
say:32:1623266024:1.source_cn: 咩，听起来这件事解决了？那火灾又怎么说呢？我可是被吓坏...

say:34:1623266025:0.text: N-No! It's not all Mr. Sweep's fault!
say:34:1623266025:0.source_cn: 不！这件事不能全怪斯威普先生！

say:35:1623266026:0.text: That day I slipped into a lake... Mr. Sweep stayed with me. He calmed me down and let me warm up by his flame.
say:35:1623266026:0.source_cn: 那天我不小心掉进湖里，是斯威普先生安抚了我，还用烛火帮...

say:36:1623266027:0.text: Anyway... that fire was an accident. He didn't mean for any of it to happen.
say:36:1623266027:0.source_cn: 那场火灾……的确是个意外，绝对不是斯威普先生的本意的。

say:37:1623266028:0.text: I'm so sorry. I know how terrifying a forest fire is... I wish I could just put my flame out whenever I needed to...
say:37:1623266028:0.source_cn: 真对不起，我知道森林火灾很可怕……要是我能随时熄灭我的...

say:39:1623266029:0.text: Neigh... you've made your case. One last question, then. Why did you leave the Serene Lyceum to stay in this forest?
say:39:1623266029:0.source_cn: 咴……看来你们能证明你们的善意。那么，我还有最后一个问...

say:41:1623266030:0.text: The simple question even gets Candel tongue-tied. Sweep drops his gaze, avoiding every set of eyes.
say:41:1623266030:0.source_cn: 听到这个问题，一向能说会道的坎德尔变得支支吾吾，斯威普...

say:43:1623266031:0.text: Your answer matters if you truly want a place here.
say:43:1623266031:0.source_cn: 如果你们真想成为森林的一员，这个问题的答案对我们至关重要。

say:45:1623266032:0.text: Sweep stays quiet. Candel looks to you, half pleading, half panicked.
say:45:1623266032:0.source_cn: 斯威普依旧沉默着，而坎德尔求助般地望向了你。
say:45:1623266032:0.male: Sweep stays quiet. Candel looks to you, half pleading, half panicked.
say:45:1623266032:0.female: Sweep stays quiet. Candel looks to you, half pleading, half panicked.

choice_prompt:46:1623266032.text: Sweep stays quiet. Candel looks to you, half pleading, half panicked.
choice_prompt:46:1623266032.source_cn: 斯威普依旧沉默着，而坎德尔求助般地望向了你。
choice_prompt:46:1623266032.male: Sweep stays quiet. Candel looks to you, half pleading, half panicked.
choice_prompt:46:1623266032.female: Sweep stays quiet. Candel looks to you, half pleading, half panicked.

say:48:1623266033:0.source_cn: 你说得对，魔法师大人，我、我们……其实是……

say:51:1623266036:0.text: We were created to make life easier, but something went wrong—bad craft, flawed spell, who knows. We're not like the others. We can talk, but always mess up everything we're supposed to do.
say:51:1623266036:0.source_cn: 魔法师创造我们本是为了让生活更加便利，但不知是制作疏忽...

say:52:1623266037:1.text: Yeah. I sweep and still leave dust. He lights a room and drips wax everywhere. No matter how hard we try... we can't get it right.
say:52:1623266037:1.source_cn: 是的……打扫时会留下灰尘，照明时会把蜡油弄得到处都是…...

say:53:1623266038:1.text: So they tossed us into a storage corner and forgot we existed.
say:53:1623266038:1.source_cn: 最后我们就被扔在库房角落里，再也没了用武之地。

say:54:1623266039:1.text: Then I found a book that said the forest has room for every kind of life... and I thought, maybe even defective things like us could belong somewhere.
say:54:1623266039:1.source_cn: 后来我无意中读了一本书，书里说森林能包容一切生命……我...

say:55:1623266040:1.text: That's why Candel and I left the Serene Lyceum. We came here hoping to start over.
say:55:1623266040:1.source_cn: 所以我才和坎德尔一起离开莱希拉姆，来到了这片森林，打算...

say:56:1623266041:1.text: And we still... managed to ruin it.
say:56:1623266041:1.source_cn: 可结果……我们还是把一切都搞砸了。

say:58:1623266042:0.text: A low, commanding growl from the heart of the woods breaks the silence.
say:58:1623266042:0.source_cn: 就在所有人沉默的时候，丛林深处响起威严的低吼。

choice:46:0:1.source_cn: 坦诚相待，才能获得真正的信任

choice:46:1:2.text: Tell the truth to clear it up.
choice:46:1:2.source_cn: 把实情说出来，才能解开误会
choice:46:1:2.male: Tell the truth to clear it up.
choice:46:1:2.female: Tell the truth to clear it up.

say:2:1623267002:0.text: I've heard enough to understand what happened. And I'm glad you're finally speaking plainly and listening, too.
say:2:1623267002:0.source_cn: 事情的前因后果我已知晓，我很高兴你们彼此能敞开心扉，认...

say:3:1623267003:1.text: Now that everyone knows the truth... What's your decision?
say:3:1623267003:1.source_cn: 现在，各位已经了解了一切，那么你们的决定是什么？

say:4:1623267004:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I will bear witness to your final choice.
say:4:1623267004:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I will bear witness to your final choice.
say:4:1623267004:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I will bear witness to your final choice.

say:6:1623267005:0.text: I've been thinking that if it weren't for Mr. Sweep, I might've frozen to death by the lake.
say:6:1623267005:0.source_cn: 我在想……如果不是斯威普先生，也许我早就冻死在湖边了。

say:8:1623267006:0.text: Exactly! And we'd have been hauled off by poachers without them! I say we let them stay!
say:8:1623267006:0.source_cn: 没错！如果那天不是他们，我们就被偷猎者带走了！我支持让...

say:12:1623267008:0.text: Woof! If they're willing to learn a bit more about how the forest works, then it's fine by me.
say:12:1623267008:0.source_cn: 汪，如果他们愿意再多学习一些森林的知识，那我也愿意让他...

say:14:1623267009:0.text: Give them time. Neigh, I say yes.
say:14:1623267009:0.source_cn: 给他们一些时间吧，咴，我同意这件事。

say:16:1623267010:0.text: Squirrels, rabbits, sheep, dogs, horses... Voices rise from every corner. Eventually, the forest finds one answer: Candel and Sweep may stay.
say:16:1623267010:0.source_cn: 松鼠、兔子、羊、狗、马……动物们纷纷发表了自己的看法，...

say:17:1623267011:0.text: Hepler gives you a nod, telling you it's time. You turn to Candel and Sweep. Relief, gratitude, and anticipation shine in their eyes.
say:17:1623267011:0.source_cn: 赫普向你点了点头，示意你宣布这个结果。你微笑着望向坎德...
say:17:1623267011:0.male: Hepler gives you a nod, telling you it's time. You turn to Candel and Sweep. Relief, gratitude, and anticipation shine in their eyes.
say:17:1623267011:0.female: Hepler gives you a nod, telling you it's time. You turn to Candel and Sweep. Relief, gratitude, and anticipation shine in their eyes.

choice_prompt:18:1623267011.text: Hepler gives you a nod, telling you it's time. You turn to Candel and Sweep. Relief, gratitude, and anticipation shine in their eyes.
choice_prompt:18:1623267011.source_cn: 赫普向你点了点头，示意你宣布这个结果。你微笑着望向坎德尔与斯威普，你从他们的眼神看到了兴奋和感激，还有期待。
choice_prompt:18:1623267011.male: Hepler gives you a nod, telling you it's time. You turn to Candel and Sweep. Relief, gratitude, and anticipation shine in their eyes.
choice_prompt:18:1623267011.female: Hepler gives you a nod, telling you it's time. You turn to Candel and Sweep. Relief, gratitude, and anticipation shine in their eyes.

say:22:1623267013:0.text: Cheers burst out. Leaves flutter like applause. Seems like the whole forest is celebrating the arrival of two new members.
say:22:1623267013:0.source_cn: 动物们欢呼雀跃，草木枝叶摇动，整个森林都仿佛在为两位新...

choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 从现在起，坎德尔和斯威普加入森林大家庭！

say:0:1623269001:0.source_cn: 故事有了一个美好的结局，真不错……再去和赫普老师聊聊吧。

say:1:1623270001:0.text: Thanks for your help, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. You brought this to an ending so bright it feels like standing in a field of sunflowers.
say:1:1623270001:0.male: Thanks for your help, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. You brought this to an ending so bright it feels like standing in a field of sunflowers.
say:1:1623270001:0.female: Thanks for your help, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. You brought this to an ending so bright it feels like standing in a field of sunflowers.

choice_prompt:2:1623270001.male: Thanks for your help, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. You brought this to an ending so bright it feels like standing in a field of sunflowers.

say:3:1623270002:0.source_cn: 这是自然，大家都喜欢美好的故事。

choice_prompt:4:1623270002.source_cn: 这是自然，大家都喜欢美好的故事。

say:5:1623270003:1.text: Haha. That's up to them. But I think they'll manage. Look.
say:5:1623270003:1.source_cn: 哈哈，这是他们自己的事情了。不过我觉得他们能做到，你看——
say:5:1623270003:1.male: Haha. That's up to them. But I think they'll manage. Look.
say:5:1623270003:1.female: Haha. That's up to them. But I think they'll manage. Look.

say:7:1623270004:0.text: You follow his gaze and spot Candel and Sweep bouncing over, vibrating with energy.
say:7:1623270004:0.source_cn: 你将目光转向赫普示意的方向，看到坎德尔和斯威普一蹦一跳...
say:7:1623270004:0.male: You follow his gaze and spot Candel and Sweep bouncing over, vibrating with energy.
say:7:1623270004:0.female: You follow his gaze and spot Candel and Sweep bouncing over, vibrating with energy.

say:9:1623270005:0.text: L-Lord Owlbear, w-we wanted to ask for your help.
say:9:1623270005:0.source_cn: 呃枭、枭熊大人，我们……有件事希望能获得你们的帮助。

say:10:1623270006:0.text: Please teach us everything we should've learned before. We can't call this place home if we don't even know how it works.
say:10:1623270006:0.source_cn: 我们希望你能教授我们森林的各种知识，我们必须要对自己的...

say:11:1623270007:0.text: And... I'd like to learn how to light my flame and put it out whenever I choose.
say:11:1623270007:0.source_cn: 啊，还有，我希望能学会自由点亮和熄灭烛火的本领……

say:12:1623270008:0.text: Excellent. But the "tuition" doesn't come cheap...
say:12:1623270008:0.source_cn: 很好啊。不过我的“学费”可不便宜——

say:13:1623270009:0.text: Tuition? Don't tell me we're job-hunting again!
say:13:1623270009:0.source_cn: 呃，学费？难道我们又要去找工作了？

say:14:1623270010:0.text: Ha! Here's what you have to do: teach the forest how to identify poachers' traps, especially the magical kind.
say:14:1623270010:0.source_cn: 哈，这次的学费是——请你们教一教森林中的动物，如何识别...

say:15:1623270011:0.text: You two can sense magic better than most. That talent is exactly what we need out here.
say:15:1623270011:0.source_cn: 你们对魔法有足够的认知和感应，这本事在森林里正有用。

say:16:1623270012:1.text: Done! Any fancy little magical trap out there won't escape my eyes!
say:16:1623270012:1.source_cn: 没问题！那些花里胡哨的魔法陷阱，绝对逃不过我的眼睛！

say:17:1623270013:0.text: And I can keep watch at night...
say:17:1623270013:0.source_cn: 我也可以在夜里为大家放哨……

say:19:1623270014:0.text: Candel and Sweep fire off questions about animal habits. Hepler walks them through it patiently, and like a real instructor, even assigns them homework.
say:19:1623270014:0.source_cn: 斯威普和坎德尔当场提了几个关于动物习性的问题，赫普都耐...

say:20:1623270015:0.text: When they're gone, Hepler turns back to you. The sternness melts from his face, replaced by quiet pride and a gentle smile.
say:20:1623270015:0.source_cn: 目送他们的背影消失后，赫普转向你，平日里严肃的神情柔和...
say:20:1623270015:0.male: When they're gone, Hepler turns back to you. The sternness melts from his face, replaced by quiet pride and a gentle smile.
say:20:1623270015:0.female: When they're gone, Hepler turns back to you. The sternness melts from his face, replaced by quiet pride and a gentle smile.

say:22:1623270016:0.text: They're going to stumble and make mistakes. Still... they won't give up learning how to adapt. And that's the part worth smiling about.
say:22:1623270016:0.source_cn: 他们的学习进度或许不会太快，也难免会犯错，但他们的确在...
say:22:1623270016:0.male: They're going to stumble and make mistakes. Still... they won't give up learning how to adapt. And that's the part worth smiling about.
say:22:1623270016:0.female: They're going to stumble and make mistakes. Still... they won't give up learning how to adapt. And that's the part worth smiling about.

say:23:1623270017:0.text: Maybe, one day your names might end up in a storybook. After all, how often does the forest adopt magical creations?
say:23:1623270017:0.source_cn: 说不定某天你和他俩的名字就会被写进书里成为经典故事。毕...
say:23:1623270017:0.male: Maybe, one day your names might end up in a storybook. After all, how often does the forest adopt magical creations?
say:23:1623270017:0.female: Maybe, one day your names might end up in a storybook. After all, how often does the forest adopt magical creations?

choice_prompt:24:1623270017.text: Maybe, one day your names might end up in a storybook. After all, how often does the forest adopt magical creations?
choice_prompt:24:1623270017.source_cn: 说不定某天你和他俩的名字就会被写进书里成为经典故事。毕竟这可是独二无三的，被森林接纳的魔法造物！
choice_prompt:24:1623270017.male: Maybe, one day your names might end up in a storybook. After all, how often does the forest adopt magical creations?
choice_prompt:24:1623270017.female: Maybe, one day your names might end up in a storybook. After all, how often does the forest adopt magical creations?

say:25:1623270018:1.text: You don't need a flawless start. A clumsy but genuine heart can still reach people.
say:25:1623270018:1.source_cn: 即使相遇时并不完美，但一颗笨拙的真心，往往是打开所有心...
say:25:1623270018:1.male: You don't need a flawless start. A clumsy but genuine heart can still reach people.
say:25:1623270018:1.female: You don't need a flawless start. A clumsy but genuine heart can still reach people.
